visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses and a black shirt stands in front of a lush green background featuring large banana leaves. He speaks directly to the camera with high energy, using frequent hand gestures to emphasize his points. Large white text overlays with shadows appear at the top and bottom of the frame, providing headlines and subtitles. (2) The scene cuts to a technical graphic illustrating a photonic chip structure. The diagram displays layers like 'Pump light,' 'Programming illumination,' and 'Output light' with accompanying spectral graphs on the right side showing intensity over wavelength. The background remains the same green plants. (3) Returning to the speaker, he now holds a blue pen, using it as a prop while explaining complex concepts. His facial expressions are animated, with a slight frown of concentration and a wide mouth movement during speech. The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot. (4) A second technical diagram appears, showing an electrode, photoconductor, and SiN waveguide. Physics formulas regarding programmable nonlinearity are visible. The man's hands are occasionally seen gesturing at the bottom of the frame while the graphic is displayed. (5) The speaker continues his explanation, moving his hands rhythmically. He appears to be in an indoor studio environment that uses real plants as a textured backdrop. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his features without harsh shadows. (6) A series of data charts and graphs appear on the screen, labeled 'Random walk,' 'With feedback,' and 'Without feedback.' These charts show fluctuating red and green lines representing laser wavelength and normalized efficiency over time. (7) The final phase shows the man concluding his talk. He shifts his gaze slightly to the side at the very end, looking at someone off-camera with a curious and humorous expression, maintaining a lighthearted tone.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 訂閱挺健康 掌握健康指南. [Slogan]: 突破！能模仿任何光學功能的光子晶片. [Subtitle]: 晶片界的「乙骨憂太」誕生. (2) [Subtitle]: 來自 NTT Research、康乃爾與史丹佛的團隊. (3) [Subtitle]: 成功打造出全球第一個「可程式化非線性光子波導」晶片. (4) [Subtitle]: 成果剛登上《Nature》. (5) [Subtitle]: 它的佈線叫做「光波導」. (6) [Subtitle]: 是刻在晶片上，讓光通過的「通道」. (7) [Subtitle]: 而它的「功能區」就是能過濾特定光柵. (8) [Subtitle]: 狗卷天生是咒言. (9) [Subtitle]: 專業術語叫「施加偏壓」. (10) [Subtitle]: 用綠光在光感應層上「畫」出導電區域. (11) [Subtitle]: 觸發所謂的「電場誘導非線性效應」. (12) [Subtitle]: 你比較喜歡乙骨被身子.
